description: Trace a file's impact closure. Runs `fallow dead-code --impact-closure <path> --format json --quiet` and returns the transitive affected-but-not-in-diff set plus coordination gaps for file-contract consumers. Evidence for review planning, not proof that affected files are wrong. Gaps carry `search_visibility`; see fallow://tools/impact_closure. Supports root, config, production, workspace, no_cache, and threads.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

path.description: Project-relative path to the file whose impact closure to trace.

production.description:
Production mode: exclude test, story, and dev files, only start/build
scripts, and report type-only dependencies.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: impact_closure
